collocations: table, serve at table; offer, provide with,” from Latin servire “be a servant,
be in service, be enslaved;” figuratively “be devoted; be governed by;
comply with; conform; flatter,” originally “be a slave,” related to servus
serve the country：效力国家
serve as her office：做她的办公室
serve useful purpose：起作用
serve the interests of all the people：符合全体民众的利益
words.definition: &vi. 对……有用；上（菜、饮料） vt. 为……服务；提供；满足，对……有益 vi. 任职
words.etymology: Late 12c., “to render habitual obedience to,” also “minister, give aid, give help,” from Old French servir “to do duty toward, show devotion to; set “slave,” which is of uncertain origin.
examples: Serve the cakes warm. 烤饼要趁热端上来
words.mnemonic: serve：give help, do duty toward, serve at table, provide with→对……有

collocations: the local bus service：当地的公交线路
customer service：客户服务
obtain the services of a top photographer：得到了一位顶级摄影师的服务
words.definition: 服务；效力；交通线路；公共服务机构
examples:
Mining rose by 9.1%, manufacturing by 9.4% and services by 4.3%.
采矿业增长了9.1%，制造业增长了9.4%，服务业增长了4.3%。
words.mnemonic: serv-（服务）+ -ice（名词后缀）→服务；效力；交通线路；服务机

collocations: prepare several servings of soup：准备几份汤
words.definition: （供一个人吃的）一份食物 adj. 上菜用的
examples:
Pile the potatoes into a warm serving dish.
把土豆堆在一只上菜的热盘子里。

collocations: a large Victorian family with several servants：
public servants：公务员
salad servers：分色拉用的叉匙
the fastest server in tennis：最快的网球发球手
words.definition: 服务器；侍者；（网球、羽毛球等的）发球员

words.mnemonic: service（服兵役）+ man（男人）→服兵役的男人→（男）军人

collocations: in-service courses：在职学习课程
words.mnemonic: in-（在……期间内）+ service（供职）→在供职期间的→在职期间进

collocations: do a disservice to the nation：对国家造成危害
words.mnemonic:
dis-（使相反）+service（服务；效劳）→即服务造成伤害而不是益处
→引申词义伤害，危害

collocations: merit, be worthy of：值得；应得
deserve a rest：该休息一下了
deserve a mention：值得表扬
words.mnemonic: de-（加强语气）+serve（服务）→因热情服务而得到某项权利→to

collocations: to give money to a deserving cause：把钱捐给值得赞助的事业

an issue deserving of attention：值得注意的问题
反义词：undeserving：不够格的；不该得到的
examples: He was undeserving of her affections. 他不配得到她的爱。

collocations: underserved areas：服务匮乏的地区
be underserved by capital：资金匮乏
words.definition: 服务不周到的；服务匮乏的
words.mnemonic: under-（=below：低于）+serve（服务）+-d→低于服务水平的→服务

collocations: a dessert wine：餐末甜酒 the dessert trolley：（餐厅内）送甜点的手推
words.mnemonic:
des-（=remove：移走）+-sert（=serve：服务）→停止正餐服务、收
拾餐桌后吃的→餐后甜点

words.etymology: 13世纪，含义为“servant：仆人”，来自古法语sergent, serjant “（domestic） servant, valet; court official; soldier”：家仆，宫廷官 员，士兵"。后用于指军事衔级中士，警官。 笔 记 区
examples:
A police sergeant patrolling the area spotted flames at the shop.
在该地区巡逻的一名警官发现那家商店失火了。

words.definition: （尤指法国公寓等处的）看门人；（宾馆中负责提供信息、订票等的）服务台职员
words.etymology: 来自拉丁语conservus “fellow slave：仆人同伴”。
examples:
When I asked for the key to the room, the concierge handed me several
messages. 当我要房间钥匙的时候，旅馆服务员递给我几张便条。
words.mnemonic:
con-（=together：一起）+-cierge（=slave：奴隶，来自serv-：服务）
→一起做仆人，服务别人的人→看门人；服务台职员
